question: How do I submit my capstone project?
answer: Submit the report (PDF), repository link and 5-minute demo video through the demo project portal by 17:00 on the deadline in the academic calendar. Late submissions lose 10% per day for up to 3 days.

question: When are capstone project evaluations?

question: How is my capstone project graded?
answer: A panel of at least two faculty plus the guide uses the demo rubric: problem definition 15%, design 20%, implementation 30%, testing 15%, report and presentation 20%.

answer: Yes. Request a re-review within 3 working days of the panel scores being published.
